policy: One primary Genesis wallet identity; additional network-specific payment addresses are registered in the same profile only after independent ownership proofs. Payments are accepted only from pre-registered addresses on their matching network. The primary wallet alone authorizes Genesis account actions. Wallet-app labels/provider metadata are not ownership proof.

outsideCurrentWave.note: Kept outside this five-wallet test wave; this is not a general disqualification. A wallet may qualify for Ethereum or Solana if those routes pass. To use TRON for Genesis payments, it must also support a valid TRON address-link ownership proof; native TRON send capability alone is insufficient.

minimum: Connect and prove control of one primary address with a domain-bound off-chain signature
Use the primary address as the sole Genesis identity, login, account authority and recovery anchor
Connect the same wallet application on any additional network the owner intends to use
Prove control of every additional network address with its own fresh, network-specific domain-bound signature
Verify every signature server-side against address, network, nonce, purpose, domain, identity and expiry
identity.tronIdentity: TRON signing is not required to establish primary identity on Ethereum or Solana. A TRON address must independently pass the TRON address-link challenge before it can originate a Genesis qualifying payment.

minimum: Initiate USDT from an address already verified and registered as a PAYMENT address in the primary Genesis wallet profile for that same network
Bind the payment intent to the primary identity and that pre-registered source address
Independently verify that the actual on-chain sender exactly matches the registered address, canonical USDT asset, treasury, amount, success, finality and uniqueness
payment.attribution: Genesis does not rely on wallet notifications. The actual sender must exactly match a previously verified PAYMENT address belonging to the same primary Genesis identity and network. The existing D1 schema and trigger enforce this pre-registration rule. Read-only parsers and two-source reconciliation are implemented; the payment-intent API, live RPC clients and entitlement-credit writer are not. Genesis does not accept unlinked one-time payment sources.
walletProviderNotRequired: A dApp provider on every accepted payment network if the wallet is not used on that rail
A wallet callback or browser event announcing payment completion
Wallet-vendor recovery/restore testing on every network
payment.networkSelection: A wallet application need not support all three rails. The participant may use only rails for which the app can expose and independently prove the corresponding network address and initiate canonical USDT transfer. An address without a network-specific ownership proof cannot be used for Genesis payment on that rail.
payment.tronAddressProof: A TRON address used for Genesis payment must pass the TRON wallet-link challenge. A native transfer alone does not establish profile ownership.
payment.genesisAddressPolicy: One primary wallet identity; independently verified network addresses grouped under that identity; only the primary wallet authorizes Genesis actions; payment sender must match a pre-registered address.

minimum: Provide a valid Solana recipient address
Prove control of a separate Solana delivery address by an off-chain Solana message signature or a separately approved equivalent
Confirm that the wallet can receive the ACROWN SPL token
delivery.transferActor: AstroCrown's separately authorized Solana treasury/distribution signer submits the ACROWN transfer. The participant wallet is the recipient and does not need to sign or send the ACROWN transfer.
walletProviderNotRequired: Participant-side Solana transaction signing for token receipt
Participant-side SOL gas payment for an AstroCrown-signed delivery

notRequiredForWalletQualification: Registering payment addresses on all three networks when the participant does not intend to use all three rails
Connecting to a dApp on every payment network the participant does not intend to use
Sending and receiving USDT on all three networks in every wallet application
Wallet-vendor recovery/restore testing across all three networks
The participant wallet signing or sending the ACROWN delivery transaction

serverVerification: exact Transfer event sender and treasury
exact Transfer event sender and treasury
canonical USDT mint and Token Program
exact source and treasury token-account owners

systemWideGates: Every Genesis payment source address must already be independently verified and registered as a PAYMENT address under the same primary identity and network; no unlinked one-time payment-source exception is permitted.
The primary wallet alone authorizes Genesis account actions; linked network addresses prove only their own control and never receive login, recovery, profile or entitlement-administration authority.
Each enabled payment rail passes its own independent chain-evidence and finality tests
Two independently operated RPC providers agree on the same normalized transfer evidence before payment credit
A server-created payment intent binds identity, payment purpose, selected network, exact asset, treasury and amount
Network plus transaction ID plus transfer or instruction index is unique and duplicate observations are idempotent
A verified payment creates only the separately defined purchase entitlement; it does not itself issue ACROWN
ACROWN purchase uses a contemporaneous approved ACS pure-floor quote and consumes entitlement atomically
The Solana ACROWN destination is verified and the outgoing token transfer is independently reconciled
All financial events are append-only and corrections are compensating events

productionAcceptance.reason: The payment-intent and one-time on-chain payment-source binding/write path are not implemented. Live identity signatures, selected payment-route confirmation, verified Solana recipient and SPL receipt tests on installed wallet builds also remain incomplete. The narrowed policy does not require each wallet to sign on all three payment chains or undergo three-chain restore testing.
